name: trim-comment-metadata
title: 注释精简：去掉任务编号、日期与 PRD 引用
description: Trim code comments across src, tests and benchmarks to concise statements about the code itself: drop task names, dates, PRD/design item numbering and redundant narration, while preserving every comment that explains a non-obvious invariant or records a deliberate decision.
